subject: Sleepiness Decomposed: The Hidden Physics of Fatigue
script: From Agewell Brief: Sleepiness Decomposed: The Hidden Physics of Fatigue. A new model splits sleepiness into two physiological axes—intensity and phase—unifying aging, caffeine, and circadian misalignment under one quantitative framework. Sleepiness is not a vague feeling. It is a physiological signal with measurable dynamics, yet it has resisted precise prediction. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
